## Live Oak Bancshares, Inc. Announces Date of Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


10/07/2026


Download (opens in new window)


WILMINGTON, N.C., Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Live Oak Bancshares, Inc. (NYSE: LOB) today announced it will report third quarter 2026 financial results after U.S. financial markets close on Wednesday, October 21, 2026.


In conjunction with this announcement, Live Oak will host a conference call to discuss the company's financial results and business outlook on Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. ET.


The call will be accessible by telephone and webcast. A supplementary slide presentation will be posted to the website prior to the event, and a replay will be available for 12 months following the event.
